Hi Aisha,

I just finished the Quickstart guide (great docs — helped a lot) and spun up a test instance. I hit a couple of questions that are blocking us from integrating:

- We want to understand latency/throughput expectations for 1-2k token requests in a private deployment.
- Curious about model variants Redwood recommends for short, developer-facing assistants vs. high-throughput batch inference.

We are a small infra/dev team at FinTech Co and this came from a docs CTA that said "Schedule a tech walkthrough." Can we book a 30-min technical demo next week? Pref times: Thu/Fri mornings PST (10–12 PT) or Mon afternoon PT.

A couple extra details: we plan to try Dedicated or Private eventually, but want to confirm architecture and any prerequisites first. Attached a screenshot of the error I saw when toggling quantization.

Thanks —
